description:
You are a video game designer building documentation for your indie game project. Using TiddlyWiki at http://localhost:8080, create a comprehensive Game Design Document (GDD) wiki for the game 'Echoes of the Void'.

Create ALL of the following 6 tiddlers:

1. 'Echoes of the Void - GDD Hub': Master hub tiddler. Include a game concept overview (genre, setting, target audience), a table of all GDD sections (columns: Section | Description | Status), and [[wikilinks]] to each of the other 5 tiddlers.

2. 'Echoes of the Void - Core Mechanics': Describe the core gameplay loop and include a table comparing at least 3 distinct mechanics (columns: Mechanic | Description | Player Goal | Challenge Level).

3. 'Echoes of the Void - Character Roster': List at least 3 major characters with a table (columns: Name | Role | Special Ability | Weakness | Brief Backstory).

4. 'Echoes of the Void - World Design': Describe the game world and include a table of at least 3 distinct areas or levels (columns: Area | Description | Primary Enemies | Key Items).

5. 'Echoes of the Void - Story and Narrative': Describe the story premise and include a table of story acts/beats (columns: Act | Title | Summary | Key Events).

6. 'Echoes of the Void - Technical Requirements': Cover target platforms, engine, and performance specs. Include a table (columns: Requirement | Minimum Spec | Recommended Spec).

All 6 tiddlers must:
- Be tagged with both 'GDD' and 'EchoesOfTheVoid'
- Use TiddlyWiki section headings (!! for major sections, !!! for subsections)
- Include at least one wiki table (rows using | pipe character syntax)
- Contain at least one [[wikilink]] pointing to another tiddler in this set
- Each contain at least 80 words of substantive content

No login is required. The wiki is available at http://localhost:8080.

required_tiddlers: Echoes of the Void - GDD Hub
Echoes of the Void - Core Mechanics
Echoes of the Void - Character Roster
Echoes of the Void - World Design
Echoes of the Void - Story and Narrative
Echoes of the Void - Technical Requirements
